result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a pedestrian signal, providing basic infrastructure for walkers. However, the wide turning radius and lack of traffic calming measures suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows vehicles to make right turns at higher speeds, increasing risk to pedestrians in the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the sidewalk meets the road.

hazards.name: Pavement Degradation
hazards.description: Cracking and wear in the asphalt near the crosswalk could present a minor tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, within and adjacent to the crosswalk markings.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles by tightening the corner radius.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking any dedicated infrastructure such as sidewalks, crosswalks, or signals. The wide, unmarked expanse of pavement and large turning radii suggest a design focused entirely on high-speed motor vehicle throughput.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No sidewalks or crosswalks are present, leaving pedestrians unprotected and forced into the roadway.

hazards.name: High-Speed Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, sweeping curb radii and a lack of lane markings encourage high vehicle speeds through the intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand turn area and main intersection

interventions.title: Pedestrian Infrastructure Installation
interventions.description: Construct sidewalks, ADA-compliant curb ramps, and marked crosswalks to provide a safe path of travel.

interventions.title: Signalization Upgrades
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to the existing traffic signals to provide protected crossing phases.

interventions.title: Intersection Tightening
interventions.description: Reduce curb radii to slow turning traffic and shorten pedestrian exposure time across the wide roadway.

result.summary: The intersection lacks essential pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, despite being in a residential area. The roadway pavement is in poor condition with visible cracking and patches, further degrading the environment for all users.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing areas for pedestrians at a signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracked and patched asphalt creates uneven surfaces and potential trip hazards.

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: Lack of sloped transitions makes the intersection inaccessible for wheelchair users or those with limited mobility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads to provide clear timing information for crossing.

result.summary: The intersection is signalized and includes a modern curb ramp with tactile paving, yet it lacks marked crosswalks and visible pedestrian signals. The roadway pavement is significantly degraded, and the absence of lane markings creates an undefined environment that increases pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted markings to designate pedestrian crossing paths.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the foreground and side street approaches

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and surface wear in the asphalt can create trip hazards and reduce vehicle traction.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.
